plan.title: Portfolio classification and tracking coverage
plan.goal: Make every plan and its child work individually classifiable, routable, and visible from authoritative sources.
success_criteria: Every indexed plan has valid classification metadata or a visible unresolved reason.
Plans route durable goals, slices, and tasks to their tracker manifests and operational actions to their owning registries.
Portfolio coverage and unresolved records are displayed without hand-entered progress or lifecycle status.

phases.name: Coverage visibility
phases.goal: Expose portfolio classification coverage and per-record resolution state.

phases.name: Source reconciliation
phases.goal: Classify each existing record from primary evidence and route child work to its authoritative tracker or registry.

items.name: Expose classification coverage in portfolio dashboard
items.goal: Show classified and unresolved totals and filter individual unresolved records.
items.validation_goal: Focused tests verify coverage rendering, unresolved filtering, and existing dashboard behavior.
items.editorial_note: Initial implementation in progress; completion remains projector-derived.

acceptance.note: Owner chat 'I accept installer + portfolio' 2026-10-08; evidence: portfolio: commits 54fe5b2b/2d65dfba/a4a9a8d5; tests plans-index 31, program-progress 31; live /api/pm/progress embeds aq-plans-index on every dashboard fetch (53/113 classified, 60 explicitly unresolved)

items.name: Individually classify indexed plan records
items.goal: Add evidence-backed classification and tracking routes for all plan directories, leaving uncertain cases visibly unresolved.
items.validation_goal: Every indexed record has valid metadata or a specific unresolved issue, with counts reconciling to the index.
items.editorial_note: Live index (2026-10-08): 53 of 113 records classified from explicit primary-record evidence (tracker.json plan declarations and round.json round records); 60 remain visibly unresolved, each with a recorded reason. Continue owner source review without inferring from names or recency.

items.name: Map goals, slices, tasks, and actions to SSOT sources
items.goal: Ensure durable child work lives in plan trackers and operational actions link to their authoritative registries.
items.validation_goal: Development map documents routes and coverage checks; no duplicate manual progress source is introduced.
items.editorial_note: Map now documents portfolio coverage and AQ-OS child routes: req-guest-init-evaluation in the requirements inventory and PID1 in the program milestone projector. Lifecycle changes and archival remain out of scope.
